topic_title: Adjusting Speed for Poor Weather & Flash Floods
prompt: Why are Texas highways most dangerously slick during the first twenty to thirty minutes of rainfall?

options.text: Asphalt road temperature drops instantly by forty degrees causing surface freeze
Rainwater mixes with accumulated motor oil and grime creating an oily film
Highway electronic speed limit display signs temporarily turn off for safety
Tire rubber expands rapidly in the first minutes of rain reducing traction
